generator_metrics: N/A for CPU/RSS after run container cleanup; runner captured main natural completion and OOM flag. Docker stats returned 0/0 and is not used.

minute_correlation.definition: Per-minute cap_iter_ms complete-iteration histogram P99 bucket, using only full seconds within each UTC minute. WAL/checkpoint counters are nearest-boundary sample deltas; whole-window WAL values are exact stream-window deltas. pg_waits is wait-event-type sampled concurrent sessions, not duration or event names.
